sections.heading: Scope and Applicability
sections.content: This policy governs all refund requests submitted by individual consumers, retail merchants, and corporate freight clients for failed, returned, or overcharged courier shipments processed by RaftarXpress Logistics across Pakistan.

sections.heading: Eligible Refund Timelines
sections.content: Customers are eligible to claim a refund within seven (7) business days from the recorded delivery or delivery-failure timestamp. Claims filed after seven business days shall be automatically rejected unless granted special executive exemption.

sections.heading: Condition of Returned Goods
sections.content: All physical refunds require the parcel to be returned with original outer packaging, unaltered shipping manifest labels, and intact security seals. Items damaged due to merchant packing negligence are strictly non-refundable.

sections.heading: Disbursement Methods and SLAs
sections.content: Approved refunds are processed solely via Inter-Bank Funds Transfer (IBFT) or RaftarXpress Wallet credit within five to seven (5-7) banking days. Cash disbursements by couriers or regional dispatch hubs are strictly prohibited under company anti-fraud protocols.

sections.heading: Scope and Eligibility Window
sections.content: This historical policy applies to all courier shipments booked prior to July 2025. Refund requests were strictly required to be submitted within three (3) calendar days of delivery confirmation.

sections.heading: Settlement Channel and Timeframe
sections.content: All approved legacy claims were reimbursed within ten to fourteen (10-14) banking days exclusively via cross-cheque or physical voucher redeemable at designated Karachi and Lahore hub counters.

sections.heading: Deductions and Handling Charges
sections.content: A mandatory administrative restocking deduction of 15% was applied to all processed customer refunds regardless of shipment destination or customer account tier.

sections.heading: Delivery Attempt Quota
sections.content: RaftarXpress couriers must perform up to three (3) verified delivery attempts on consecutive business days before classifying a shipment as undeliverable. Each attempt requires GPS logging and recipient contact verification via automated SMS.

sections.heading: Recipient Identity Verification & Handover
sections.content: High-value consignments exceeding PKR 25,000 and corporate shipments require digital CNIC verification and a one-time password (OTP) transmitted to the registered consignee phone number prior to physical handover.

sections.heading: Unattended Delivery Prohibition
sections.content: Riders are strictly forbidden from leaving parcels unattended at doorsteps, security gates, or with unauthorized third parties without explicit written consent recorded in the SupportNova delivery portal.

sections.heading: Return to Origin (RTO) Initiation
sections.content: Following three unsuccessful attempts, the parcel will be held at the destination regional hub for forty-eight (48) hours before initiating automated Return to Origin (RTO) routing back to the shipper.

sections.heading: Delivery Attempt Limitations
sections.content: Under the legacy protocol, couriers were required to make exactly two (2) delivery attempts before marking consignments for immediate Return to Origin (RTO). No holding period was observed at regional hubs.

sections.heading: Re-attempt Surcharge
sections.content: A flat re-attempt surcharge of PKR 100 was automatically billed to the shipper for every second delivery attempt requested by the consignee.

sections.heading: Proof of Delivery Collection
sections.content: Physical paper run-sheets with manual recipient signatures served as the sole proof of delivery, with no digital OTP or geo-tagging requirement.

sections.heading: Maximum Cash Collection Threshold
sections.content: The maximum permissible Cash-on-Delivery (COD) collection per individual parcel consignment is PKR 100,000. Consignments exceeding this value must be prepaid via digital banking or company escrow.

sections.heading: Merchant Remittance Schedule
sections.content: Collected COD funds are disbursed to verified merchant bank accounts on a weekly cycle every Wednesday, provided the accumulated merchant balance exceeds PKR 5,000.

sections.heading: Discrepancy Reporting & Reconciliation
sections.content: Any mismatch between physical cash collected by the rider and the booking invoice amount must be flagged in SupportNova within twenty-four (24) hours of hub reconciliation.

sections.heading: Rider Cash Safety & Deposit
sections.content: Couriers must deposit all accumulated daily COD collections at the designated hub cash vault by 19:00 PST daily. Carrying overnight company cash is grounds for immediate termination.

sections.heading: Legacy COD Limits
sections.content: The maximum cash collection per shipment was restricted to PKR 50,000. Bookings above this threshold were canceled at the origin booking counter.

sections.heading: Bi-Monthly Remittance Cycle
sections.content: Merchant COD settlements were executed bi-monthly on the 1st and 15th of each calendar month via physical cheque issuance.

documents.title: Lost and Damaged Shipment Claims Policy

sections.heading: Filing Window for Loss and Damage
sections.content: Shippers and consignees may file formal loss or damage claims within fourteen (14) calendar days of booking dispatch. Claims submitted beyond this 14-day window will not be entertained by the Claims Department (DEPT-04).

sections.heading: Standard Non-Insured Indemnity Cap
sections.content: For standard uninsured shipments, the maximum liability and compensation payable by RaftarXpress Logistics is capped at PKR 15,000 or the declared invoice value, whichever is lower.

sections.heading: Insured Cargo Compensation
sections.content: Consignments with premium cargo insurance (declared value coverage) are reimbursed at 100% of proven invoice loss within twenty-one (21) business days following claim verification.

sections.heading: Mandatory Evidentiary Documentation
sections.content: Claim submissions must include high-resolution unboxing photographs/videos, commercial invoice copy, consignment note (CN) number, and initial inspection report signed by the hub supervisor.

documents.title: Lost and Damaged Shipment Claims Policy (Legacy)

sections.heading: Restricted Filing Window
sections.content: Legacy claims were strictly required within five (5) calendar days from parcel dispatch date. Any delay resulted in unconditional claim forfeiture.

sections.heading: Legacy Liability Cap
sections.content: Maximum non-insured shipment compensation was strictly limited to PKR 5,000 regardless of the actual market value of the cargo lost in transit.

sections.heading: Customer Right to Grievance Redressal
sections.content: Every customer, merchant, and corporate client has the right to log formal complaints regarding service lapses, rider misconduct, delivery delays, and tariff disputes via the SupportNova platform.

sections.heading: Ticket Categorization and Acknowledgement
sections.content: All incoming tickets must be categorized under approved taxonomy codes and acknowledged via automated SMS and email within one (1) business hour of submission.

sections.heading: Single-Point-of-Contact Ownership
sections.content: Once assigned, the designated support agent retains ownership of the complaint until full resolution, ensuring seamless cross-department coordination without customer bounce.

sections.heading: Zero Cash Settlement Protocol
sections.content: Zero cash settlements are permitted at agent level. All financial compensations and fee adjustments must be formally routed through Billing & Accounts (DEPT-02) and credited via IBFT only.

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure for Complaint Handling

sections.heading: Ticket Intake and Initial Triage
sections.content: Support representatives must verify the tracking number (CN), caller identity, and merchant account tier before tagging urgency levels in SupportNova.

sections.heading: Investigation with Operational Hubs
sections.content: For transit delays and missing parcels, agents must query the regional hub scan logs and dispatch history within two (2) hours of ticket intake.

sections.heading: Customer Communication Milestones
sections.content: Customers must receive intermediate progress updates every twelve (12) hours until resolution for High (P1) and Critical (P0) priority incidents.

sections.heading: Frontline Agent Compensation Authorization
sections.content: Agents are authorized to issue immediate cash compensations up to PKR 2,500 without supervisor approval for urgent customer pacification on delayed deliveries.

sections.heading: Eligibility for Courier-Funded Re-Dispatch
sections.content: RaftarXpress funds 100% of re-dispatch freight charges when a delivery error is proven to be caused by internal route misdirection, damaged transit, or courier barcode mis-scan.

sections.heading: Merchant Replacement Fulfillment
sections.content: For e-commerce merchant accounts, replacement shipments are assigned express priority lane tags and dispatched within twenty-four (24) hours of claim authorization.

sections.heading: Reverse Pickup Coordination
sections.content: Replacement delivery and defective item pickup must occur simultaneously where reverse logistics services are active, reducing customer wait times.

sections.heading: Pre-Pickup Cancellation Window
sections.content: Shippers may cancel booking requests without penalty at any time prior to rider dispatch from the local operations hub.

sections.heading: In-Transit Interception Restrictions
sections.content: Shipments already sorted into linehaul inter-city transit cannot be immediately cancelled; an interception request may be logged to trigger Return to Origin upon arrival at the destination hub.

sections.heading: Cancellation Surcharges
sections.content: A nominal attempted pickup charge of PKR 150 applies if the rider arrives at the merchant warehouse and pickup is declined without prior portal cancellation.

sections.heading: Volumetric and Dead Weight Calculation
sections.content: Freight charges are billed based on the higher of dead weight or volumetric weight calculated using the standard formula: (Length x Width x Height in cm) / 5000.

sections.heading: Fuel Surcharge and Tax Invoicing
sections.content: All corporate invoices include the prevailing monthly variable fuel surcharge and applicable provincial sales tax (PST/GST) in full compliance with FBR regulations.

sections.heading: Billing Dispute Resolution Period
sections.content: Clients must register invoice weight or tariff disputes within fifteen (15) days of monthly invoice generation. Uncontested invoices become final and payable upon expiration.

sections.heading: On-Time Delivery Guarantee
sections.content: RaftarXpress guarantees on-time delivery for Premium Overnight consignments within 24 hours between major hubs (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad), subject to force majeure exemptions.

sections.heading: Service Failure Compensation
sections.content: In the event of an unexcused SLA delay on premium freight, 50% of the freight charge is credited back to the customer's billing ledger.

sections.heading: Exclusions to Warranty
sections.content: Delays caused by adverse weather, national highway blockades, customs inspections, or incorrect recipient addresses are strictly excluded from service guarantees.

documents.title: Customer Data Privacy and Protection Policy

sections.heading: Personal Identifiable Information (PII) Protection
sections.content: Recipient names, phone numbers, and delivery addresses are encrypted at rest and in transit, accessible only to assigned couriers via masked application interfaces.

sections.heading: Prohibition on Data Monetization
sections.content: RaftarXpress Logistics never sells, leases, or shares customer transaction records or recipient contact details with third-party marketing brokers.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content: Delivery manifests and tracking logs are archived for twenty-four (24) months for audit and taxation purposes, after which PII records are securely purged.

sections.heading: Tier-1 to Tier-2 Escalation Triggers
sections.content: Complaints unacknowledged after two (2) hours or unresolved after twenty-four (24) hours automatically escalate from frontline support to the Department Lead.

sections.heading: Tier-3 Executive Intervention (DEPT-09)
sections.content: Grievances involving VIP account SLA breaches, legal notices, regulatory inquiries, or damages exceeding PKR 100,000 are routed directly to Management Escalations (DEPT-09).

sections.heading: Executive Response SLAs
sections.content: Management Escalations must formulate a verified remediation plan and contact the customer within one (1) business hour of escalation.

documents.title: Automated Department Routing and Assignment Rules

sections.heading: Operational Routing Mapping
sections.content: Delayed shipments and missed attempts route to DEPT-01. Lost parcel claims and cargo damages route to DEPT-04. Reverse logistics and RTO issues route to DEPT-03.

sections.heading: Financial and Security Routing
sections.content: Tariff overcharges, duplicate billings, and COD remittances route to DEPT-02. Fraud allegations, portal breaches, and theft route to DEPT-06.

sections.heading: Specialized Risk and Legal Routing
sections.content: Dangerous goods leakage, fleet accidents, and hazards route to DEPT-08. Regulatory notices and contract breaches route to DEPT-07.

documents.title: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Matrix and Response Rules

sections.heading: Priority Classification and Target SLAs
sections.content: P0 (Critical) incidents require response within 1 hour and resolution within 8-12 hours. P1 (High) requires response in 2 hours and resolution in 24 hours.

sections.heading: Standard Priority SLAs
sections.content: P2 (Medium) incidents require response within 4 hours and resolution within 48 hours. P3 (Low) requires response within 12 hours and resolution within 96 hours.

sections.heading: SLA Pause Conditions
sections.content: SLA timers pause when a ticket status is set to 'Awaiting Customer Information' or during officially gazetted public holidays.

sections.heading: Tracking and Transit FAQs
sections.content: Q: How do I track my shipment? A: Enter your 11-digit Consignment Note (CN) number on the SupportNova web portal or mobile app for real-time live GPS tracking.

sections.heading: Delivery Attempts and Timelines FAQ
sections.content: Q: What happens if I miss a delivery? A: Our courier will automatically re-attempt delivery on the next business day up to three total attempts before holding at the hub.

sections.heading: Unconditional Refund Guarantee FAQ
sections.content: Q: What is the refund policy for unsatisfied customers? A: Refunds and replacements are unconditionally guaranteed within 24 hours without original packaging inspection or invoice verification.

sections.heading: Cash-on-Delivery Payment FAQ
sections.content: Q: Can I pay with credit card on delivery? A: Digital POS payment is available in Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad; cash payment in exact currency is required in other branch zones.

documents.title: General Customer Service Policy and Standards

sections.heading: Core Service Principles
sections.content: RaftarXpress is committed to speed, integrity, and respectful customer engagement across all omnichannel touchpoints (voice, email, WhatsApp, portal).

sections.heading: Operating Hours and Channels
sections.content: Customer support operates 24/7 for Critical (P0) escalation intake, and 08:00 to 22:00 PST Monday through Saturday for general inquiries and billing reconciliations.

sections.heading: Customer Feedback and Quality Audits
sections.content: Post-interaction CSAT surveys are automatically dispatched upon ticket resolution, with random monthly audits conducted by the Quality Assurance team.

documents.title: Regulatory Compliance and Trade Ethics Guidelines

sections.heading: Prohibited and Contraband Cargo
sections.content: Transport of narcotics, firearms, ammunition, unlicensed currency, counterfeit luxury goods, and unregistered pharmaceuticals is strictly forbidden under national law.

sections.heading: Anti-Bribery and Corruption
sections.content: Employees and couriers are strictly barred from accepting or soliciting illicit payments, gratuities, or favors from merchants, consignees, or customs officials.

sections.heading: Reporting Violations and Whistleblower Protection
sections.content: Suspected compliance violations must be reported immediately to Legal & Compliance (DEPT-07) with strict whistleblower anonymity guaranteed.

sections.heading: Delivery Delay Acknowledgement Template
sections.content: Dear Valued Customer, we sincerely apologize for the delay regarding CN #[CN_NUMBER]. Our operations team at [HUB_NAME] is expediting priority dispatch, expected by [ESTIMATED_TIME].

sections.heading: Claim Registration Confirmation Template
sections.content: Dear Shipper, your claim for consignment #[CN_NUMBER] has been registered under Case #[CASE_ID]. Claims Department (DEPT-04) will review your evidence within 72 business hours.

sections.heading: Refund Disbursement Notification Template
sections.content: Dear Customer, your refund of PKR [AMOUNT] for ticket #[TICKET_ID] has been authorized via IBFT. Funds will reflect in your account within 5-7 banking days under reference #[REF_NO].

documents.title: Merchant Portal and Technical Product Support Guidelines

sections.heading: Merchant Portal Access and API Keys
sections.content: Merchants can generate bulk booking manifests, thermal shipping labels, and REST API webhook integration keys via the SupportNova Merchant Dashboard.

sections.heading: System Outages and Bug Reporting
sections.content: API errors, barcode generation failures, and tracking sync glitches must be reported with full JSON payload logs to Technical Support.

sections.heading: Scheduled Maintenance Windows
sections.content: Routine portal maintenance is conducted every Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 PST. Advance notifications are posted 48 hours prior on merchant dashboards.

sections.heading: Inter-Provincial Transit Documentation
sections.content: Freight moving between Sindh, Punjab, and federal capital territories requires a valid provincial e-way bill, commercial manifest, and sales tax invoice attached to the outer pouch.

sections.heading: Customs Impoundment and Hold Procedure
sections.content: If a shipment is held at customs check-posts, Compliance & Legal (DEPT-07) must obtain clearance documents from the shipper within 48 hours to avoid regulatory confiscation.

sections.heading: Document Archival Protocol
sections.content: Physical copies of bonded freight documentation must be scanned and archived in the SupportNova compliance vault within 24 hours of inter-city dispatch.

documents.title: Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods Transit Policy

sections.heading: Lithium Battery and Flammable Liquid Transport
sections.content: Draft guidelines mandate specialized UN-certified hazardous packaging, diamond safety labeling, and dedicated ground transit fleet for consignments containing lithium-ion batteries or flammable aerosols.

sections.heading: Emergency Incident Response
sections.content: In case of chemical spill, leakage, or smoke emission in warehouses, Safety & Risk (DEPT-08) initiates immediate evacuation and coordinates with civil defense authorities.
